name: hexstrike-ai
description: Connect MCP clients to a running HexStrike AI API server.
long_description: Provides HexStrike AI tools through a Python MCP server. Requires Python 3.10 or newer with the dependencies in requirements-mcp.txt installed, and a separately running HexStrike AI API server.

tools.name: server_health
tools.description: Check HexStrike AI API server health and tool availability.

python_path.title: Python executable
python_path.description: Select a Python 3.10+ executable with requirements-mcp.txt installed, such as .venv-mcp/Scripts/python.exe on Windows or .venv-mcp/bin/python on Linux/macOS.

server_url.title: HexStrike API URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the running HexStrike AI API server.
